images.title: Guiding ships through history
images.caption: National Lighthouse Day
images.desc: Every August 7, National Lighthouse Day shines a light on the beacons that have guided ships safely along America's coasts for centuries. The date commemorates the Lighthouse Act of 1789, signed into law by President George Washington.
